source: Maharashtra Agricultural Produce Marketing (Development and Regulation) Act, 1963 (with subsequent amendments)
jurisdiction: Government of Maharashtra, Directorate of Marketing
description: Statutory APMC market cess, weighment, and handling tariffs for accurate Net In-Hand Realisation modeling

commission_agent_adath.regulatory_status: Paid by Buyer under modern Maharashtra APMC rules; farmer is exempt

net_realisation_formula.equation: Net_Realisation_Per_Quintal = Modal_Price - Transport_Freight - (Modal_Price * Mandi_Cess_Pct) - Hamali - Tolai - (Daily_Storage_Rent * Wait_Days)
